metric_notes.quote_groups: Each evidence_groups row is an OR group; any audited strict quote or verified line-reanchored citation in that group counts as covered.
metric_notes.line_reanchored_quotes: Auxiliary calibrated metric; every normalized source-line anchor, including repeated lines, must occur in one packed chunk on the cited page. Strict quote coverage remains separate.
metric_notes.page_document_recall: Unique-page and document recall use the union of citation alternatives. The alternative-aware evidence_page_group_recall and evidence_document_group_recall count a group when any cited page or document in that group is retrieved.
metric_notes.hg_case_associations: Extra and missing packed HG links are scored only on answerable, non-ambiguous rows with at least one known HG case mapped from cited gold pages. Gold cases are the union of known case links on all cited alternative pages; unknown links and unindexed corpus pages are invisible.
metric_notes.peer_ambiguity: Rows listed in peer_ambiguous are excluded from the incorrect case-association diagnostic.
